<description>
The connman fuzz target never exercised `m_nodes` peers with queued messages, as their message queue is always empty. The most they ever had to send was handshake bytes in the case of v2 peers, so the socket handler only ever waited for SendEvent, and sent data, during a v2 handshake.

Fix this by pushing messages to one of the `m_nodes` peers instead of `random_node`, which is never added to connman.
</description>

<commits>
ad51e87ecf fuzz: push a message to an actually connected node in connman target

Pushing a message to random_node, which is never part of connman's
m_nodes, meant that whatever data left in vSendMsg was never picked up,
and that actual peers in m_nodes mostly never had anything to send (the
queue of all nodes added with AddTestNode() was always empty, and the
v2 peers only ever had their handshake bytes to send).

Fix this by pushing messages to a peer chosen amongst connman's m_nodes
instead, to increase meaningful coverage of connman's operations.
</commits>
